Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Request: KMS access playback + rotation witness material for SIG submission

Marissa,

Thanks again for taking time earlier. As part of our SIG / CAIQ submission for BrightWave we need a short package showing a KMS access "playback" for a sample rotation event and operator activity across a 30-day window. Specifically we're asking for:  

- A sanitized playback CSV showing operator sessions, commands, and KEK/DEK rotation markers (timestamps)
- HSM seal/attestation PDF or signed statement for the rotation date range
- A short runbook (2–3 pages) describing who performs rotation, access controls, and redaction guidance for auditor review

Can you confirm whether Red•wood can provide a playback CSV and attestation by EOD Thursday (2028-05-25)? Also advise if you prefer we receive raw logs or a redacted package — auditors here prefer minimally redacted logs plus a redaction map.

If helpful, Taylor at BrightWave is copied for context on the account timeline.

Appreciate it,

Janet Miller
Lead Auditor, AuditSuite
[janet@auditsuite.com]

[attachment hint: SIG-questionnaire-gap-list.pdf (PDF, 46KB)]

Subject: Re: Request: KMS access playback + rotation witness material for SIG submission

Janet —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redaction-map-backed playback package and a signed HSM attestation. High-level plan:  

1) Playback CSV: we will export a 30-day slice with operator session identifiers, command text (redacted values only), key-version markers, and rotation timestamps. File name will be kms-rotation-log-sample.csv.
2) HSM attestation: signed seal PDF that references the rotation event and operator signatures (hsm-seal-attestation.pdf).
3) Runbook summary: condensed runbook/playback notes (playback-runbook-v2.md) with a redaction map describing which fields were masked for external review.

A few clarifying Qs:  
- Do you need full command arguments or is masked/placeholder values acceptable (we typically mask plaintext key material and long ARNs)?
- For operator identities, do you accept role names + ephemeral session IDs, or do you need full user principal names?

Ben (cc'd) will attach the sample CSV and the redaction map in his next reply; Vanessa will provide the attestation timeline and sign-off statement. If that meets your needs we'll put the playback package in the shared drive link below and send a short checklist for your auditor team.

I plan to route the DocuSign for the attestation once Vanessa confirms the signatories. Target: deliver by 2028-05-25 EOD as requested.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Security PM — Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment 1: kms-rotation-log-sample.csv (stub) 
- Fields: timestamp, session_id, operator_role, command_type, key_version, event_marker
- Redaction: command arguments replaced with <REDACTED>, key identifiers truncated to last 8 chars
